theses.thesis: T1: Operating leverage keeps EPS compounding even as gross margin compresses.
theses.signpost: Operating expenses stay below 20% of revenue in each 2026 quarterly report, and FY2026 diluted EPS lands near the US$0.85 consensus [3]. Nu reports an efficiency ratio rather than opex-to-revenue; this update uses it as the proxy.

theses.thesis: T2: Credit losses stay contained at about 15% of receivables, so gross margin stabilises.
theses.signpost: The expected credit loss ratio on cards and loans stays at or below 15.4% in each 2026 quarterly report.

theses.thesis: T3: The current valuation prices in a sharp growth slowdown, so the stock can re-rate if revenue keeps growing.
theses.signpost: FY2026 revenue reported in the 2026 20-F (early 2027) at or above the US$22.3 billion low end of consensus [3].

theses.thesis: T4: Deposit funding keeps the balance sheet self-sustaining without new equity.
theses.signpost: Deposit growth stays above 25% on an FX-neutral basis, and TTM free cash flow turns positive in the FY2026 20-F (early 2027).
